rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3092:obj:0: Read the ⟦E11⟧ and speak to ⟦E12⟧ in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:3092:details:0: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, ⟦12⟧. I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:3092:progress:0: Welcome to ⟦E14⟧, ⟦14⟧. I hear good things about you. Your bloodline is strong, and many of the elders consider you skilled already. But that we will test.⟦15⟧⟦16⟧The plains of ⟦E15⟧ will be your home for sometime--you should do your best to learn it very well. One day you will travel to unfamilar lands to master greater skills. You must be ready.
rows.quest:3092:completion:0: And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession--how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.
rows.quest:3092:completion:1: Hunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, ⟦17⟧. You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.

rows.quest:3108:details:0: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the hunter trainer Thorgas. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3108:progress:0: Ya made it! Good to hear! Betcha didn't have to track me to find the place either. Haha!⟦18⟧⟦19⟧Our profession is pretty steeped in tradition, ⟦20⟧. rows.quest:3108:completion:1: I'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. I'll train you when I can.

rows.quest:6061:details:0: As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.
rows.quest:6061:details:1: In the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.
rows.quest:6061:progress:0: Practice your skills, ⟦29⟧. Tame the adult plainstrider.
rows.quest:6061:completion:0: Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; you have done well.

rows.quest:6062:details:0: It is an admirable skill to command one's authority over nature. As a hunter, you must strive to learn to use the force and power inherent to any creature of your choosing.
rows.quest:6062:details:1: Gaining control of an animal is not an easy feat; it is a task that you must undertake with much determination.
rows.quest:6062:details:2: For your first assignment, take this taming rod and use it to tame a dire mottled boar. You can find them quite close to Razor Hill. Practice your skills in battle with the boar at your side, then return to me.
rows.quest:6062:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦31⟧. I believe you are ready for your next task.

rows.quest:6063:details:0: As a hunter, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.
